title: Lighter’s Next Chapter w/ Trevor King, Head of IR & Growth
summary: In this episode of Galaxy Grid, the hosts and Trevor, Head of Investor Relations at Lighter, analyze the recent crypto market cooldown, noting Bitcoin's pullback to $77,000, rising oil prices, and the highly anticipated FOMC rate decision. The group breaks down the US regulatory landscape for perpetual derivatives, exploring the Clarity bill cloture vote and CFTC licensing pathways. Trevor highlights Lighter's white-glove partnership approach, which includes a recent integration with Robinhood Chain where real-world assets (RWAs) now make up 70% of open interest. Finally, the conversation unpacks Lighter's zero-fee retail execution model, their 100% revenue buyback structure for the LIT token, and upcoming product milestones like onchain orderbook options and cross-collateral portfolio margining.
